==Please, read carefully==
''Written by la gleki''

The book placed here is for grown-ups who want to learn Lojban.

It's not for children who learn to read.

It's for those who already speak English.

The idea is that we select Lojban constructs that resemble its English translations, we make Lojban and English closer to each other in style. The goal is that Lojban is more easily accumulated. Other Lojban styles can be learnt later by other methods.

In other words, this book is a launching pad to fluency in Lojban.

===What do I need?===
I need help from you.
# If you are learning Lojban please say  a word of what you do or do not like in this book.
# If you are already fluent in Lojban please correct my mistakes by reporting them.
# If you speak another language apply the same method to your language and translate the book. I can help you with adding actual text to the pictures if you want that.
